prompt: A photograph from a lens fixed high on a bathroom wall, looking down at a cramped space under a basin where a narrow cupboard door stands open. Brandon lies on his side on a dry lino floor with head and shoulders under the sink, a spanner in one hand, the other hand on a chrome isolation valve, a small torch clamped in his teeth lighting the pipes. His brows are lifted and his eyes crinkled with delight. The floor is dry and the colours are washed out. A single overhead strip light lights the room. Thanks.
